For me, Juneteenth commemorates the enduring spirit of the ancestors, who could not take a moment to pause. In their honor, today is about reflection, release, reverence, and above all, rest.

Resting is a way to hold space for ourselves and is a powerful act of resistance in a society that expects us to keep going, to continue producing, to perpetually give. By taking moments to simply be, we honor the resilience and lack of volition of those who came before us. We plant seeds of self love in a sacred space within us, facilitating our own healing from generational trauma.

So today, be gentle with yourself, do less without guilt, and know that every restorative moment of rest brings you closer to wholeness.

–Donnie, Founder of High Light Rituals
